# Agentic RAG

> Agentic retrieval built from scratch: query decomposition, a self-querying retriever-agent, and iterative multi-hop retrieve-reason-retrieve.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag

## Source

- [src/agentic_rag/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/__init__.py): Agentic RAG - iterative multi-hop retrieval driven by an agent.
- [src/agentic_rag/agent.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/agent.py): The agentic retrieval control loop.
- [src/agentic_rag/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/cli.py): Command-line interface for agentic retrieval.
- [src/agentic_rag/core/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/core/__init__.py): Core abstractions for agentic retrieval.
- [src/agentic_rag/core/postings.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/core/postings.py): Compact inverted-index postings and exact top-k selection.
- [src/agentic_rag/core/retrieval.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/core/retrieval.py): Core types and a self-contained retriever for agentic retrieval.
- [src/agentic_rag/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/data.py): A bundled multi-hop corpus and labeled questions.
- [src/agentic_rag/decomposition.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/decomposition.py): Query decomposition: splitting a complex question into answerable sub-questions.
- [src/agentic_rag/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/evaluation.py): Evaluating agentic retrieval against a single-hop baseline.
- [src/agentic_rag/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/agentic_rag/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the agentic retriever.
- [src/agentic_rag/synthesis.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agentic-rag/blob/main/src/agentic_rag/synthesis.py): Answer synthesis and a follow-up (self-query) generator.
